packageRules.description: Disable Renovate's built-in github-actions manager — gx owns workflow and composite-action files
Schedule gx.toml-driven action major upgrades on the first day of the month

Default apt suites for debian:13-slim: trixie plus trixie-security; trixie-updates is omitted, no pin resolves from it. Mirrors the base image's own sources — update these together with the base image in android.Dockerfile, since a Debian release bump makes them stale. The trixie-security URL currently 404s on every run and is silently skipped: Renovate's deb datasource hardcodes Packages.gz, which Debian does not publish on the delta suites (renovatebot/renovate#44330). It is kept because it records where apt really resolves these packages from, and starts working with no edit once that lands.

openjdk-17 is not in trixie; the android stage adds Debian 12 bookworm to install it. Mirrors config/debian_12_bookworm.sources, minus bookworm-updates, from which no pin resolves. bookworm-security is load-bearing, not optional: the only installable openjdk-17-jdk-headless is published there and nowhere else, because a security upload moved openjdk-17-jre-headless and the JDK declares Depends: openjdk-17-jre-headless (= <same version>) — see #555. Renovate cannot currently fetch it (hardcoded Packages.gz vs the Packages.xz Debian publishes on the delta suites — renovatebot/renovate#44330), so this URL 404s and is silently skipped; it is kept because removing it would state that the pin comes from somewhere it does not. Must stay after the trixie rule — a later matching rule replaces registryUrls.

customManagers.description: Read GitHub Action specifiers from gx.toml

Read Debian apt-package pins from *.Dockerfile. Which suites a pin resolves against is owned by the deb packageRules above — deliberately not by this manager, because a registryUrlTemplate can only ever emit one URL and correctness needs a set.
